title: Al-Haqil Attends Board Meeting of the Persons with Disabilities Authority
summary: Al-Haqil participated in a board meeting of the Persons with Disabilities Authority. The meeting likely discussed strategic initiatives and policies related to the welfare and rights of individuals with disabilities within the jurisdiction.
body:
Al-Haqil participated in a board meeting of the Persons with Disabilities Authority. The meeting likely discussed strategic initiatives and policies related to the welfare and rights of individuals with disabilities within the jurisdiction.
